technical.summary: ACN shows long-term bullish structure with price above key moving averages and positive trend indicators, but overbought oscillators and negative MACD histogram signal near-term pullback risk; moderate confluence with neutral sector backdrop limits swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 84 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts, mixed party, no senior leadership pattern
sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no composite signal; market fear (40 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (411.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, imminent NFP event (1 day), and earnings binary 84 days out create a highly unfavourable risk environment for ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with supertrend and hull bullish signals provide long-term structural support, and VIX crisis creates contrarian opportunity for mean-reversion positioning.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (stoch, williams_r, stochrsi), negative MACD histogram, weak intermediate trend (EMA 20/50 not bullish), imminent NFP event, VIX crisis macro environment, and high earnings risk in 84 days create excessive near-term pullback and binary event risk.

decision.primary_risk: Overbought oscillators combined with negative MACD histogram and weak intermediate trend (EMA 20/50 not bullish) signal imminent pullback risk; VIX crisis macro environment and earnings binary 84 days out create excessive downside exposure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 11 other IT holdings (23% sector concentration) and macro crisis conditions (VIX 411.2, flat yield curve, NFP event in 1 day) warrant avoiding additional exposure.
